items.title: Arrhenius rate constant
items.sutra: घातः २ अककः घातांकः ळचखस्य घातेन ३ ऋणम् १ एकः घातांकः घातस्य २ टः ररः ऋणम् १
items.declarations: प्रकरणम् अककः ळञख एकः ळञख टः ळञख ररः ळञख ।
items.gloss_en: the product of A and the power, with exponent minus the product of E and the reciprocal of the product of T and R, of e
items.units: E/(R T) dimensionless; result in the unit of A
items.meaning: Reaction rate constant rising steeply with temperature.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Nernst potential
items.sutra: सङ्कलनम् २ उककः घातः ५ ऋणम् १ टः ररः ळखकः ककके घातांकः घातस्य २ नः फफः ऋणम् १
items.declarations: प्रकरणम् उककः ळञख टः ळञख ररः ळञख कककः ळञख नः ळञख फफः ळञख ।
items.gloss_en: the sum of U and minus the product of T, R, the natural logarithm of Q and the reciprocal of the product of n and F
items.units: volts when R T/(n F) is in volts
items.meaning: Electrode potential shifted from standard by the reaction quotient.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Henderson-Hasselbalch
items.sutra: सङ्कलनम् २ पः घातः २ ळखकः घाते २ बः घातांकः अकस्य ऋणम् १ घातांकः ळखकस्य १० ऋणम् १
items.declarations: प्रकरणम् पः ळञख बः ळञख अकः ळञख ।
items.gloss_en: the sum of p and the natural logarithm of b divided by a divided by the natural logarithm of 10
items.units: pH is dimensionless; b/a a ratio
items.meaning: pH of a buffer from its base to acid ratio.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: First-order decay
items.sutra: घातः २ चः घातांकः ळचखस्य घातेन ३ ऋणम् १ कः तः
items.declarations: प्रकरणम् चः ळञख कः ळञख तः ळञख ।
items.gloss_en: the product of c and the power, with exponent minus the product of k and t, of e
items.units: k in 1/time; result in the unit of c
items.meaning: Concentration of a species decaying at a rate proportional to itself.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Ideal gas law
items.sutra: घातः ४ टः नः ररः घातांकः ववकस्य ऋणम् १
items.declarations: प्रकरणम् टः ळञख नः ळञख ररः ळञख ववकः ळञख ।
items.gloss_en: the product of T, n, R and the reciprocal of V
items.units: pressure in the unit implied by R
items.meaning: Pressure of an ideal gas; P = n R T / V.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Langmuir isotherm
items.sutra: घातः ३ खः पः घातांकः सङ्कलनस्य २ १ घातः २ खः पः ऋणम् १
items.gloss_en: the product of K, p and the reciprocal of the sum of 1 and the product of K and p
items.units: coverage fraction, dimensionless; K p dimensionless
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling
